groups.g: Water (v3, sits on the sculpted bed)
items: A lake or pond skin, 0.02 m thin. Its shoreline is the sculpt_basin formula, so give the basin under it the same rx/rz/wobble/seed. Drop it at the water level: bed + 0.8 x depth.
One reach of a river or stream. It wanders on the sculpt_channel formula, so give the channel under it the same len/meander/seed. Chain reaches with ry, never uphill.
One flat sea with a swell, and no bed at all — dish a sculpt_shelf into the ground under it. The record's y is the sea datum.
